xmldoc.short_description: Get or set the assistant file-access permission mode.

param_input_item.param_description: a string: always_ask, auto or full. An unrecognized value is ignored.

param_output_item.param_description: a string: the effective permission mode after the call.

description.p: nelson.ai.acp.permissionMode reads or changes how the assistant's file-access requests are approved. Called with no argument it returns the current mode; called with a mode it sets it and returns the effective value.
always_ask: prompt on every request. This is the default and the safest.
auto: auto-allow safe requests (read, list, search) and prompt only for risky ones (write, edit, execute, network).

The mode is session-wide and is remembered across restarts in the preferences directory, so it is set once rather than every session. The assistant pane permission selector reads and writes this value.

example_item.example_item_description: Auto-allow safe requests and prompt only for risky ones.
